mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM import_batch WHERE file_sha256 = #{sha256}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM import_batch WHERE id = #{batchId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM log_entry WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND parse_status = 'SUCCESS'

SELECT line_no, client_ip_hash, client_ip_mask, log_time, method, path, status_code, referer, user_agent, raw_line_masked FROM log_entry WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND parse_status = 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY line_no LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO import_batch (created_by, source_type, file_name, file_sha256, scenario_code, status, total_lines, parsed_lines, skipped_lines, completed_at) VALUES (#{actorId}, #{sourceType}, #{filename}, #{sha256}, #{scenarioCode}, #{status}, #{total}, #{parsed}, #{skipped}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))

INSERT INTO audit_log (actor_user_id, action, target_type, target_id, detail, trace_id, created_at) VALUES (#{actorId}, 'IMPORT', 'BATCH', #{batchId}, JSON_OBJECT('sourceType', #{sourceType}, 'batchId', #{batchId}, 'parsedLines', #{parsed}, 'skippedLines', #{skipped}), #{traceId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))

INSERT INTO log_entry (batch_id, line_no, log_time, client_ip_hash, client_ip_mask, method, path, query_string, status_code, response_bytes, referer, user_agent, raw_line_masked, parse_status) VALUES
#{value}
